# Daly Growth Media

> Daly Growth Media is a lead generation and marketing business run by Sean Daly in Ennis, Co. Clare, Ireland. The main service is Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads that turn ad spend into booked jobs for trades, home improvement and premium service businesses across Ireland. It also offers Google Ads, SEO and Google Business Profile (GMB) optimisation, and websites and landing pages.

## Key facts

- Founder: Sean Daly (Ennis, Co. Clare). Works directly with every client — no account managers or handoffs.
- Experience: over a year of running marketing for businesses; has worked with over 30 SMEs across Ireland.
- Service area: all of Ireland (based in Ennis, Co. Clare).
- Contact: sean@dalygrowthmedia.com — WhatsApp +353 87 379 2059.
- Start: a free 20-minute campaign plan call. Management pricing is discussed on the discovery call; ad spend is paid by the client directly to Meta or Google.

## Services

- Meta ads lead generation (main service): strategy, tracking, creative direction, optimisation and monthly reporting.
- Google Ads management: search campaigns with conversion tracking.
- SEO + Google Business Profile optimisation: local SEO, GMB setup and optimisation, review generation process.
- Websites and landing pages: fast, mobile-first sites and single-offer landing pages.

## Results

- Google Business Profile rating: 4.8 out of 5 from 4 reviews.
- Tar & chip driveway contractor: 102 leads at €7.91 per lead from €807.08 of Meta ad spend, generating €55,000 in job value in the first month.
- Home improvement and roofing client: 71 leads from €757.79 of ad spend, with over €50,000 of work generated from the ads.
